'''Implant Suggestion''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': -2

'''Sanity Cost''': 0

'''Movement Phase''': You may cast and exhaust while in Arkham to choose one [[monster]] in your location and have it move either in the direction of the white or black arrow in that location.
